name: chunkr-reading-order-bench-oss
description:
Chunkr Reading Order Bench - Open Source Subset
	

Open-source subset of the Chunkr Reading Order benchmark dataset, containing 733 professionally annotated documents with detailed reading order annotations across diverse document layouts.
This dataset benchmarks reading order detection models on complex, real-world documents including financial reports, legal contracts, research papers, medical records, and more. Each document includes ground truth reading order sequences essential… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ChunkrAI/chunkr-reading-order-bench-oss.
evaluation_method: F1 / sequence accuracy / ordering metrics (e.g., Kendall tau or edit distance)
reputation: An open-source, professionally annotated subset used by the document-layout and OCR communities for reading-order evaluation; recognized but relatively niche compared to larger layout datasets.
